notes.title: QOL, balance and bugfixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here are some post release changes to further stabilize the game and add some of the most requested features:

- Added a "Backpack" button, which allows to check the inventory on map screen or during a reward selection screen
- Added a new page to Adventure Guide, which shows all other status effects
- Added a possibility to spin with the [Space] key
- Added an secret achievement
- Reduced damage gained from explosives by Firecracker Pike by 2
- Changed the threshold for "The Walking Fort" achievement to 500 (total armor achievement)
- Buffed Top Hat
- Adjusted Smith's Hammer damage calculation based on armor

- Fixed an issue where Life and Mana shards would sometimes take few spins to combine
- Fixed an issue where Throwing Knife would not combine
- Fixed an issue where Firecracker Pike modifier would be visible outside the slots
- Fixed an issue where the Adventure Guide could be opened while the symbol removal menu is visible
- Fixed an issue where rune tooltip would not be visible at rune selection screen
- Fixed an issue where a symbol could be removed when opening the remove symbol menu
- Fixed a black line visible on the screen for Ultrawide display
- Fixed obstructed shop interface on Ultrawide display
- Fixed a softlock caused by removing an item while opening a chest
- Fixed an exploit allowing to gain infinite gold after killing an enemy
- Fixed an exploit allowing to select one bundle multiple times
- Fixed Fletcher's Cap not giving additional armor for spaces below
- Fixed Jango HP value display on the character select
- Fixed an issue where the opacity of the main menu would sometimes get stuck on input
- Fixed an issue with spacing between characters for bundles
- Fixed description for Blacksmith's Hammer
- Fixed an issue where map points could be selected with other menu open


Have fun everyone!

notes.title: Bundles, New Symbols and Balance changes!
notes.notes:
Hey playtesters!

New mechanic is added - Starter Bundles! These will speed up the early game, by giving you a choice of a starter bundle to kickstart your run.

New symbols: Explosives Crate, Firecracker Pike, Bombsword, Shadow Chakram, Rainbow Sword and a Fancy Top Hat!

Balance changes were mostly targeted to buff builds that were underperforming:
1. Strength Axes build is buffed
2. Strength Cooldown build is buffed
3. Strength Breaking build is buffed
4. Agility Bow build is buffed
5 Magic Mana build is buffed
6. Magic Fire build is buffed
7. Magic Debuff build is slightly nerfed

Also added some minor bug fixes and ergonomy changes,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971636/58ea7f5bb0bb984992e4ae5a3c3fa50147899605.png


Have fun!
